data.body: Scope correction for the signed historical plan: the intended 165-block inventory also includes two anchors omitted from the Scope bullets: (1) the deleted NOTE at immutable audit base 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e, tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:L59-L64, immediately before _plant_ticket; and (2) the rewritten import-path comment at that base, tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_reducer_marker.py:L27, immediately before the sys.path guard. The signed plan itself is append-only and remains unchanged; these two anchors reconcile its 163 enumerated bullets with the 165-block heading and acceptance criterion.
